title: Cat-DPO: Category-Adaptive Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2604.17299v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aligning large language models with human preferences must balance two competing goals: responding helpfully to legitimate requests and reliably refusing harmful ones. Most preference-based safety alignment methods collapse safety into a single scalar that is applied uniformly to every preference pair. The result is a model that looks safe on average but stays relatively unsafe on a minority of harm categories. We cast safety alignment as a per-category constrained optimization problem and derive Cat-DPO, a direct-preference-optimization algorithm with a separate adaptive safety margin for each harm category. The margin tightens when the model still produces unsafe responses on a category and relaxes once the model catches up, so the training signal tracks each category's current difficulty rather than averaging under one global rate. translated_title: Cat-DPO：类别自适应的安全对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17299v3 公告类型：跨版本替换。摘要：将大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐必须平衡两个相互竞争的目标：对合法请求做出有帮助的回应，以及可靠地拒绝有害请求。大多数基于偏好的安全对齐方法将安全性压缩为一个单一的标量，并统一应用于每一对偏好数据。结果是模型在平均情况下看起来安全，但在少数危害类别上仍然相对不安全。我们将安全对齐视为一个逐类别约束优化问题，并推导出Cat-DPO，这是一种直接偏好优化算法，为每个危害类别设置独立的自适应安全边际。当模型在某个类别上仍产生不安全响应时，边际会收紧，一旦模型赶上，边际会放松，因此训练信号跟踪每个类别的当前难度，而不是在一个全局速率下进行平均。在两个LLM骨干网络和六个偏好学习基线上，Cat-DPO提高了整体帮助性。
tldr: Cat-DPO提出了一种逐类别自适应安全边际的直接偏好优化方法，通过动态调整每个危害类别的训练信号，在保持整体帮助性的同时显著提升少数危害类别的安全性。
en_tdlr: Cat-DPO introduces a per-category adaptive safety margin in direct preference optimization, dynamically adjusting training signals for each harm category to improve safety on minority categories while maintaining overall helpfulness.
